name: DEEPBOM
short_description: Static evidence for attached AI deployment artifacts.
description: DEEPBOM inspects an attached TFLite, ONNX, GGUF, SafeTensors, Core ML, or ExecuTorch deployment artifact in the ChatGPT browser sandbox. It returns a hash-bound summary of serialized structure, tensor encodings, quantization evidence, and findings while keeping artifact defects, cautions, and evidence gaps separate.

data_flow.model_bytes: downloaded from the ChatGPT-authorized file URL by the sandboxed widget; not fetched or retained by the DEEPBOM service
returned_to_conversation: bounded graph, storage, and quantization summary
bounded artifact defects, cautions, and evidence gaps
data_flow.server_persistence: none for model bytes or submitted analysis results

evidence_boundary: Static serialized-artifact evidence does not establish runtime placement, measured latency or energy, task accuracy, clinical validity, safety, or regulatory compliance.
